628-4247-7188.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2034-3490-6996-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6996-7818.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5641-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5641-5805-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1368-5434-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5434-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

240-955-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6753-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4559-4802-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-5226-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

560-4550-5686-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5686-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Repeat from step 2

4616-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

220-5109-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Brash Taunter instead due to With Great Power....
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-6558.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Naga Fleshcrafter.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3168-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3168-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3168-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4067-4798-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4067-4798-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

1129-2645.notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five Allies.
1129-2645.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1129-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

678-4694--23.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
The artifact enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to it having 0 toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2500-2723.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
2500-2723.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Blazing Sunsteel until end of turn.
Activate Mirage Mirror's equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to the indestructible creature with Blazing Sunsteel attached.
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Mirage Mirror trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Mirage Mirror trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

634-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature that can attack this turn.
Hanweir Garrison and Crashing Drawbridge do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
634-2769-3259.description:
Activate Crashing Drawbridge by tapping it, giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
Declare Hanweir Garrison and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two 1/1 Human creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Hanweir Garrison, the Human tokens and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Human token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
